## Checks

- [ ] I read the relevant [CleanStack](../docs/architecture/cleanstack.md) sections. This change conforms, or it includes an explicit amendment naming the rules affected, consequences, tests and migration needs.
- [ ] No decision is marked accepted, and no framework, provider, encryption scheme or licence is chosen, unless the owner approved it.
- [ ] No real financial data, account identifiers, credentials, tokens, private screenshots or exports are included, even in docs, fixtures or logs.
- [ ] Commits are attributed only to an approved human, with no AI or automation author or co-author lines.
- [ ] The checks I ran are listed below. Anything not run is reported as NOT RUN, not as passed.
- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated formatting or generated output.
